notes.title: Demo Delay (from 18/09/2025 to 25/09/2025)
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We have an important update to share with you.[/p][p]Our demo was originally planned for [b]September 18, 2025[/b]. However, due to Steam’s review process taking longer than expected (partly because of our name change), the demo release will be slightly delayed.[/p][p]👉 [b]New Demo Release Date: September 25, 2025[/b][/p][p]At the same time, we’re excited to officially announce our new name:[/p][h3][b]WinMon[/b] ✨[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681780/WinMon/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Why we change game name?
We felt [b]WinMon[/b] better captures the spirit of the game: cute little desktop monsters who live, play, and grow alongside you—your small companions for study, work, or just relaxing.[/p][p]Thank you so much for your patience and support! This extra time will ensure the demo is polished and ready for you to enjoy.[/p][p]Stay tuned—your WinMon friends can’t wait to meet you next week! 🐾💻[/p][p]—The Dev Team[/p]
